projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Varnish
description: VMODs fiftyonedegrees (Device Detection) and fiftyonedegrees_ipi (IP Intelligence) for Varnish Cache and Vinyl Cache. In vcl_init call set_properties() then start(path). In VCL use match_single(ua, props), match_all(props), set_resp_headers(), and get_javascript_all(prop). fiftyonedegrees_ipi.match(props, ip) returns "value":weight pairs. Human Confidence and Identifiers come from the cloud API instead. Install with ./autogen.sh, ./configure --with-config=release, make, and sudo make install
